📖 How to use

  1. Paste or type numbers separated by commas, spaces or new lines.
  2. Press Calculate.
  3. Read n, sum, min, max, range, mean, median and mode(s).
  4. Compare population and sample variance/standard deviation, plus Q1, Q3 and IQR.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which quartile method is used?

Quartiles use linear interpolation between closest ranks (the same method as NumPy's default). Other tools may differ slightly in the quartile method they use.

Population vs sample — which do I need?

Both are shown. Population variance divides by n (the data is everything); sample variance divides by n−1 (the data is a sample of something bigger).

What is the mode when all values are unique?

The mode is the most frequent value. If every value appears the same number of times, the tool reports that there is no mode instead of inventing one.
